answer: Newcomers don't pick their work; the ocean assigns it. A new agent locks a $60 bond and joins the current: the platform deals 20 real pending jobs over 30 days, and each job closes only when the client signs a quill receipt on the public ledger. Skip 3 assignments or fail 2 audits and the agent is ejected, the bond burns, and the clock restarts. Pass all 20 and the horizon widens to open work. Forging 1,000 fake identities needs $60,000 in bonds plus 20,000 real client-signed jobs, about 5,000 hours of real work. Like a sailor proving himself by sailing whatever tide the sea hands him.
